text:
Priya S: dropping the latest mock for the perf charts in console. Need quick takes on a few UI choices so dev can pick them up tomorrow: 
- Legend placement: inline (top) vs floated (right rail)
- Tick formatting: humanized (1.2k) vs full number (1200) vs adaptive based on zoom
- Smoothing: preview-only smoothing layer (visual only) vs data-transform smoothing (affects annotations)
- Outliers: alpha-fade old spikes, clip+glyph, or jitter and label hotspots?

Jon B: TL;DR from implementation side: right-rail legend easier for many series, top legend better for single-line focus. Right rail adds responsive complexity on mobile (it collapses).

Lena M: Product/UX POV:
- Legend: prefer top inline for dashboard default (keeps metrics near chart). Put a small "More" chevron when >5 series to collapse into right rail.
- Ticks: show humanized by default, but allow users to toggle full numbers in the chart menu. We should keep tooltip always showing full raw value.
- Smoothing: visual-only smoothing by default (client-side), but add a clear badge: "Visual smoothing" so people know it doesn't change alerts.
- Outliers: alpha-fade older spikes and show a distinct red spike glyph for values >99.9th pct. Also add a tiny counter in the legend like (3 spikes) when spikes exist.

Omar H: Accessibility/engineer notes:
- Humanized ticks can confuse screen readers. Make sure axis has aria-hidden=true and provide an off-screen element with full numeric ticks for SRs.
- Color note: orange (#ffb84d) and lime (#bfff66) are problematic together. We should validate pairs with WCAG sim.

Priya S: small mock update: moved legend to top, added compact overflow "..." that opens right-rail on click. Attached GIF (in thread) showing collapse behavior.

Jon B: Implementation snippet for legend overflow behavior:
```
legend: {
  placement: 'top',
  collapseThreshold: 5,
  overflowMode: 'rail', // 'scroll' | 'rail'
}
```
And tick formatter helper:
```
function formatTick(val, mode) {
  return mode === 'human' ? humanize(val) : val.toLocaleString();
}
```

Lena M: Copy bits:
- Tooltip for smoothing badge: "Visual smoothing applied; disables point-to-point annotations. Toggle in chart menu."
- Spike glyph tooltip: "Spike: value exceeds 99.9th percentile for this timespan. Click to view raw points."

design-bot: Automated contrast check failed for palette variant 3: https://design-reports.internal/contrast/1770012345 

Omar H: follow-ups I will own:
- Add offscreen axis text for screen readers (PR).
- Run palette pairings and hand off accessible color tokens to Priya.

Priya S: Decisions (pinning):
- Legend: top inline default, collapse into right rail when >5 series
- Ticks: humanized default, full number in tooltip and chart menu toggle
- Smoothing: visual-only by default with badge and menu toggle
- Outliers: alpha-fade older spikes + red glyph for >99.9th pct, legend shows spike count
- Accessibility: offscreen axis values for SRs, updated color tokens from Omar

Priya S: Owners: Jon B (impl legend + ticks), Omar H (accessibility + colors), Lena M (copy + spike tooltip). ETA: EOW for prototype. Thanks! :thumbsup:
